name: a2aconnect-monorepo
description: A2AConnect — SDK-agnostic agent interop runtime (LF A2A–compatible)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @a2aconnect/core && npm run build -w @a2aconnect/adapters && npm run build -w a2aconnect-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @a2aconnect/core && npm run typecheck -w @a2aconnect/adapters
